sections.label: Town Council Sinking Fund lift replacement
sections.summary: Town Councils must set aside minimum percentages of S&CC and grants in Sinking Funds for cyclical works including lift replacement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Under the Town Councils Act and Rules, every Town Council is required to set aside a minimum of 30% for 1- to 3-room flats, or 35% for 4-room or larger flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: This is 30% or 35% of the service and conservancy charges (S&CC) collected and grants-in-aid received in a separate Sinking Fund.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: This fund will be used to fund the cyclical works, which include the replacement of lifts and lift parts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The recommended replacement cycle of 28 years for lifts serves as a guide to Town Councils in planning and budgeting for the cyclical work.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Town Councils are ultimately responsible for managing their finances and should take the appropriate measures to ensure that they have sufficient funds to carry out their statutory responsibilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: They can choose to contribute a higher percentage of their S&CC collections and grants-in-aid beyond the stipulated minimum to their Sinking Funds, or increase S&CC rates where necessary.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The Ministry of National Development (MND) is currently reviewing ways to help Town Councils plan ahead and better monitor their long-term financial sufficiency.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Given that lift replacement is a major Sinking Fund expenditure, we are also considering ring-fencing part of the Town Councils' Sinking Funds to cater for such expenditures.

sections.label: BCA lift maintenance regulations
sections.summary: BCA is looking at enhancing regulations and capabilities, including performance-based maintenance, for lift contractors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: I want to emphasise what I said earlier, that the maintenance part is equally important, and what I said earlier was that BCA is looking at enhancing its regulations as well as enhancing and strengthening capabilities in this area.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, BCA will also be looking at performance-based maintenance because, today, I think many Town Councils get a lift contractor to maintain the lifts, but you have not a lot of oversight over the performance regime that is in place for the lift contractor.
